title: FluentEmail
description: A fluent API for composing and sending emails in .NET applications.

data.text: `FluentEmail` provides a fluent, chainable API for composing and sending emails. It supports multiple renderers for Razor, Mustache, and plain text templates, and it works with SMTP, SendGrid, Mailgun, and more.

data.title: Installation
data.content: Install FluentEmail and an SMTP renderer.

data.text: Compose an email with `Email.Send()` and chain methods like `To()`, `Subject()`, and `Body()`.

data.title: Basic FluentEmail Usage
data.content: Send a simple email with FluentEmail.

data.text: FluentEmail can render Razor templates for rich HTML emails.

data.title: Razor Template
data.content: Render an email body from a Razor template.

terms.definition: The global sender used when no sender is explicitly specified.
A sender implementation that delivers email via SMTP.
Renders the email body from an embedded Razor template.

data.title: Tip
data.text: FluentEmail supports dependency injection in ASP.NET Core. Register it with AddFluentEmail and inject IFluentEmail for clean service code.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: FluentEmail uses a fluent API for composing emails
Supports SMTP, SendGrid, Mailgun, and more
Razor and Mustache templates are supported
data.takeaway: FluentEmail simplifies email composition and delivery in .NET applications.
